Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the 51-character number.

Step 4:

  • Nothing is saved and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request.", with the second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this." (part A is on work order 1's part request).

Step 5:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A keeps its number.

Step 7:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 8:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 9:

  • Part Number shows the 60-character number.

Step 10:

  • The window closes: part B saves with the 60-character number, because it is on no open part request.

Step 11:

  • Part B is listed under the 60-character number.

  • S13-N7: “If the new number is longer than 50 characters and the part sits on an open part request, the save is refused with "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request."”
